Las Vegas is well-positioned to become a crypto innovation hub due to its:

Gaming industry's adaptability to new payment systems
Tourism economy's openness to international visitors
No state income tax advantage
Existing regulatory framework for money transmission
However, federal monetary policy supremacy means Nevada cannot unilaterally make Bitcoin legal tender. Any "bi-centric" (dual fiat/crypto) system would operate within federal constraints.

The most realistic outcome is gradual integration where Bitcoin and stablecoins complement rather than replace USD, particularly in tourism and gaming sectors.
